description: Part B - add one OFFICIAL scraper adapter per SCRAPEABLE small finance bank, registered in scripts/ingest.mjs, each with an offline fixture regression test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs, then publish rates via the CI ingest workflow. Depends on FEAT-002 (category + bank entries must exist). Live page structure was discovered via the CI diagnose workflow; per-bank diagnosis findings are recorded in this feature's `findings` and in the orchestrator's delegation prompt. HARD RULE: never ship wrong/mis-tiered data under an OFFICIAL badge - document genuinely unscrapeable SFBs as BLOCKED (rate-less) in scripts/ingest.mjs comments rather than fabricating. Partial success is expected and acceptable.
steps: For each SFB confirmed to have a parseable rate page in diagnostics: create src/ingest/adapters/<id>.ts. Choose the base by structure: (a) plain/rendered (tenure, general%, senior%) or multi-column retail slab grid -> extend PrivateTableAdapter with generalCol/seniorCol (see federal.ts, kotak.ts); set renderJs:true when plain HTTP yields 0 tables; use pdfUrl when rates are only in a PDF rate card; (b) rates in a client-side JS global -> follow icici.ts (extractRateGlobals from the serialized window global, parse the retail table, c1=general c2=senior); (c) irregular multi-table page needing content-signature table selection or a serial-number leading column -> bespoke override parseFdRd like canara.ts / pnb.ts. Always map the RETAIL (< Rs 2-3 crore) slab and the correct GENERAL vs SENIOR columns (NOT bulk, NOT annualised-yield columns). SFB rates can reach ~8.5-9% (still <15, valid).

Register each new adapter in scripts/ingest.mjs: add an import from `${A}/<id>.js` and push `new <Id>Adapter()` into the ADAPTERS array, alongside a short comment block for that bank as the existing private-bank comments do.

For every SFB that is genuinely unscrapeable (image-only rates, un-renderable/interactive widget with no rate global and no rate-carrying JSON endpoint, hard 403/bot-block, or unparseable PDF), do NOT register an adapter. Instead add a concise comment in scripts/ingest.mjs documenting the bank as BLOCKED with the specific reason observed in diagnostics (mirror the existing Axis / Yes Bank comments). The bank stays rate-less (its FEAT-002 profile renders with no rate rows).

For each registered adapter add an offline fixture regression test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs following the private-bank/ICICI/canara pattern: import the compiled adapter from public/js/ingest/adapters/<id>.js, feed a fixture that reproduces the bank's real table/global structure (including the multi-column layout or serial-number column if applicable), and assert: rows are bankId=<id> + OFFICIAL; a full FD tenure ladder (>=4 distinct tenures spanning short and long); and CRITICALLY the correct GENERAL vs SENIOR retail-column tiering with sentinel values that would FAIL if the columns were swapped or a bulk/yield column were picked. Include a resilience assert (empty/garbage input -> 0 rows).
Rebuild + offline-verify: `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run typecheck`, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build`, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node scripts/test-adapters.mjs` all pass.

Commit sources + regenerated public/js/** together (adapters compile into public/js/ingest/adapters/, imported by ingest.mjs at runtime). Commit message e.g. `feat(sfb): OFFICIAL scrapers for <list of banks> (+ offline fixtures)`. Push to main.

Dispatch the ingest workflow: `gh api -X POST repos/urbdag/psb-deposit-rates/actions/workflows/ingest.yml/dispatches -f ref="main"`. Poll the run to completion; read its logs (download+unzip+grep in ONE shell command since /tmp does not persist between shell calls) and confirm each new SFB adapter reports refreshed (not 'fell back'). If a bank fell back, read WHY from the log and either fix the adapter (re-diagnose that specific URL if needed) or, if genuinely unscrapeable, demote it to a documented BLOCKED comment and re-push.

After ingest commits back to main: `git fetch origin main` and inspect public/data/dataset.json for each newly-scraped SFB - confirm rows are quality OFFICIAL, source URL on the bank's official domain, both GENERAL and SENIOR present, and rates are sane (0-15%, retail tier not bulk). Confirm the follow-on deploy run (triggered by the ingest commit) concludes success so the rates are live.
Record in this feature's findings exactly which SFBs published OFFICIAL rates vs stayed BLOCKED and why, plus the running total of banks tracked and official-source coverage count.
acceptance_criteria: Every scrapeable SFB has a registered adapter in scripts/ingest.mjs producing OFFICIAL rows for the retail (<Rs 2-3cr) slab with correct GENERAL/SENIOR columns
Every registered adapter has an offline fixture test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs asserting correct column tiering + a full ladder, and the test fails if the mapping is reverted/swapped
Genuinely unscrapeable SFBs are documented BLOCKED in scripts/ingest.mjs with the specific reason and left rate-less (no fabricated rates)
typecheck + build + test-adapters pass offline; sources + compiled public/js committed and pushed to main
A CI ingest run publishes the new SFB OFFICIAL rates; dataset.json on origin/main shows them (OFFICIAL, official-domain source, GENERAL+SENIOR, sane rates)
The deploy run following the ingest commit concludes success (rates live)
findings records the per-SFB success/blocked breakdown and the running bank + official-coverage totals
verification: git fetch origin main && git show origin/main:public/data/dataset.json | grep -oE '"bankId": "(au|equitas|ujjivan|jana|suryoday|utkarsh|esaf|capitalsfb|nesfb|shivalik|unity)"' | sort | uniq -c
findings:
Part B complete. Landed 2 OFFICIAL SFB scrapers and documented 9 as BLOCKED (rate-less, never fabricated), per the hard rule. Partial success as expected.

SCRAPED (OFFICIAL, live on origin/main + deployed):
- Capital SFB (capitalsfb): bespoke parseFdRd in src/ingest/adapters/capitalsfb.ts. The callable-domestic-term-deposit page publishes GENERAL and SENIOR in TWO SEPARATE 2-column tables (table[0]=general, table[1]=senior); parser reads both and joins by tenure (closest ref: canara.ts). renderJs:true fallback, schemeNamer for single-day specials (400 Days etc.), RD derived from FD >=1yr. Live dataset: 30 rows, all OFFICIAL, source capital.bank.in, FD+RD, GENERAL+SENIOR, rates 3.5-7.75%, 11 tenures, 0 mis-tiered.
- Shivalik SFB (shivalik): src/ingest/adapters/shivalik.ts extends PrivateTableAdapter (generalCol:1, seniorCol:2, renderJs:true) with an override findPrivateRateTable that PINS the retail '< Rs.2 Crores' 3-column table by content signature, excluding the higher-amount bulk slabs and the savings table (which carries a 7.00% top slab). Live dataset: 38 rows, all OFFICIAL, source shivalik.bank.in, FD+RD, GENERAL+SENIOR, rates 3.5-8.25%, 13 tenures, 0 mis-tiered.
Both registered in scripts/ingest.mjs ADAPTERS and each has an offline fixture regression test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs asserting bankId+OFFICIAL, a full ladder (>=4 distinct tenures spanning short+long), correct GENERAL-vs-SENIOR retail-column tiering with sentinels that fail if columns/tables are swapped or the bulk/savings table is picked, plus a garbage-input->0-rows resilience assert. The ingest CI run also re-ran the offline tests green.

BLOCKED (documented in scripts/ingest.mjs, no adapter, rate-less):
- AU (au): au.bank.in behind Cloudflare Turnstile bot-challenge; headless render returns a ~3KB challenge shell, 0 tables, no body rate text. Un-renderable.
- Equitas (equitas): Gatsby page, 0 tables, single stray 8.25% only; linked rate-card PDF (Overall_Interest_Rates...pdf) FAILED to load in diagnose (dead/rotated hash); page-data JSON has no stable tiered ladder.
- Suryoday (suryoday): Gatsby. interest-rates renders sparse stray %s (no table); the dedicated rate-of-interest page exposes exactly ONE table and it is the SAVINGS balance-slab table, not an FD GENERAL/SENIOR ladder. FD ladder only in rotating page-data/sq/d JSON, no stable tiered structure.
- Utkarsh (utkarsh): fixed-deposits page's 2 tables are a product-info table + a maturity CALCULATOR widget; dedicated rate-of-interest / interest-rates pages render 0 tables. No parseable tiered ladder.
- ESAF (esaf): interest-rate URLs return ~300-byte near-empty bodies (SSR/bot gate).
- Ujjivan (ujjivan): FD rate URLs hard-fail the headless render (goto/navigation error).
- Jana (jana): fixed-deposit page 0% rate content; rates only in linked PDFs/images that FAILED to load.
- North East / NESFB (nesfb): nesfb.com/interest-rates has no percentages (image/PDF); nesfb.bank.in fails to render.
- Unity (unity): redirects to slice.bank.in (Unity SFB now 'slice'), a Next.js site with rates only in _next data JSON, 0 tables, no captured body %s.
Each blocked SFB's FEAT-002 profile renders with no rate rows (correct: rate-less, not fabricated).

VERIFICATION: env -u NODE_OPTIONS typecheck clean; build prints 'Wrote 42 pages'; offline adapter tests all pass. Commits on main: abc1a5d (Capital+Shivalik scrapers+fixtures), c89d659 (blocked docs). Ingest run 35424306674 concluded success and reported 'capitalsfb:FD+RD, shivalik:FD+RD' refreshed (boi/federal fell back = pre-existing, unrelated). Ingest committed 9229c70 (data: daily rate refresh). NOTE: the ingest workflow pushes with GITHUB_TOKEN, which by GitHub design does NOT trigger the on-push deploy (the same reason the prior refresh 2a6e224 was deployed via a manual dispatch), so I dispatched deploy.yml on main manually (run 35424599003) which concluded success on 9229c70 - rates are LIVE. dataset.json on origin/main shows capitalsfb (30 rows) + shivalik (38 rows), all OFFICIAL, official-domain source URLs, GENERAL+SENIOR, sane retail rates, 0 mis-tiered.

RUNNING TOTALS: 31 banks tracked (12 PUBLIC + 8 PRIVATE + 11 SMALL_FINANCE). Official-source coverage: 19 banks now carry OFFICIAL rates (17 PSU/private from prior work + 2 new SFB: capitalsfb, shivalik). 9 SFBs documented BLOCKED and rate-less.

HARDENING (v1 review follow-up, offline defense-in-depth; no new ingest run needed - Shivalik LIVE rates already 0 mis-tiered): (1) shivalik.ts findPrivateRateTable now feeds the PRECEDING HEADING/section text into the retail/bulk/savings signature test via a new sectionContextFor() helper (nearest preceding <h1..h6> block, dependency-free), because the real page carries the amount-slab labels as headings ABOVE each table - invisible to the old table.toLowerCase()-only check, which silently fell back to DOM order and could have shipped BULK rates under the OFFICIAL badge on a page reorder. Now the retail '< Rs.2 Crores' table is pinned by signature regardless of DOM position. (2) extractDataRows guard tightened from `dataRows.length >= 3` (dead bound; 4 distinct tenures require >= 4 rows) to `>= 4` to match intent. (3) The Shivalik offline fixture in test-adapters.mjs was reordered so the BULK table precedes the retail table (savings still first) with slab labels as headings above the tables; bulk peak set to 8.50/8.75 vs retail 8.00/8.25. This fixture FAILS the old DOM-order logic (picks bulk 5.00 for 7-14d) and PASSES after the fix (retail 3.50), proving selection is by signature not order; existing column-tiering sentinels retained. (4) Cosmetic: three main.ts copy strings (hero subhead + two meta descriptions) aligned from 'public sector and private banks' to 'public sector, private and small finance banks' to match build-pages.mjs. Rebuilt: typecheck clean, build prints 'Wrote 42 pages', all adapter tests green. Regenerated public/js/** (shivalik.js, main.js) + public/**/*.html committed with sources; dataset.json untouched.
